why: All three checks pass. (1) The quoted sentence is verbatim at deep-links.md:39, and the WHOLE line reinforces rather than reverses it: 'A deep link never executes anything on its own. The link only chooses a directory and fills the prompt box. If you click a link from a page you do not trust, the prompt is still inert: nothing reaches the model until you read what was filled in and press Enter.' Line 45 independently confirms the one-path claim ('Every deep link starts with claude-cli://open, which is the only path the handler accepts') and line 41 confirms the 'Prompt from an external link' warning line. (2) The cited file:line is exact: apps/electron/src/renderer/contexts/NavigationContext.tsx:754 is `const shouldSend = parsed.params.send === 'true'`, inside `case 'new-session':` opened at :677, and :755-763 calls window.electronAPI.sendMessage(session.id, parsed.params.input!, ...) behind a 100 ms setTimeout. apps/electron/src/main/index.ts:197 is app.setAsDefaultProtocolClient(DEEPLINK_SCHEME) as claimed. (3) The CONSEQUENCE was verified separately from the identifier, and the external path is real and ungated end-to-end: app.on('open-url') at index.ts:~240 calls handleDeepLink unconditionally with no origin classification (the classifyExternalUrl/'dangerous' gate in main/handlers/system.ts:206-215 sits only on the renderer->main shell:openUrl IPC, not on the OS path); deep-link.ts:185-190 copies every query param except `window` and `sidebar`, so `send` survives; handleDeepLink:334-338 pushes DeepLinkNavigation to the renderer; the listener at NavigationContext.tsx:1096-1123 re-serialises actionParams back into an `action/...` route and calls navigate(); navigate() at :841 dispatches parsed.type === 'action' to handleActionNavigation at :861. No trust prompt, no origin check and no 'external link' warning string exists anywhere in apps/electron/src or the i18n bundles (grep -ani, no hits). The sibling-subsystem trap does not apply: `send=true` exists because the app uses this scheme as its own in-app command bus (new-session-deep-link.ts:25-26 'auto-sends the seeded prompt', called only from EditPopover.tsx:1089), but the same handler is registered OS-wide with no distinction between the internal caller and a web page, so the internal design intent does not bound the external surface. Not an owner decision: all nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 were read (seatbelt wildcard, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, listSessionSummaries) and none concerns deep links. Not a deliberate product difference either: only the scheme name (craft:// -> nessy://) is rebrand; auto-send and the destructive action routes are substantive behaviour. The existing records treat the page as OPEN, not decided: coverage-map row 97 marks deep-links yellow with 'Контракт не снят', and the parity audit at :1719 files deep links under 'Minor, no row, listed for completeness' — a title-level triage the audit itself says was 'not enough to audit field by field'.
correctedState: Confirmed, with three citation corrections and one mitigation the finding missed. CORRECT AS CLAIMED: nessy://action/new-session?input=…&send=true reaches window.electronAPI.sendMessage with no confirmation (NavigationContext.tsx:754-763), the scheme is registered OS-wide (main/index.ts:193/197) and dispatched unconditionally from app.on('open-url'), and there is no external-origin gate and no 'Prompt from an external link' warning anywhere. CORRECTION 1: the action is `new-session`, and deep-link.ts:22-24 is a STALE DOC COMMENT (it still says `new-chat` and lists resume-sdk-session/delete-session/flag-session) — it is not the routing table and it does not mention rename-session or oauth. The real routing table is the switch in NavigationContext.tsx starting at :672, where delete-session (-> deleteSession), flag-session/unflag-session, rename-session, oauth (-> performOAuth), delete-source and set-mode are all reachable from the same ungated OS path; cite that switch, not the comment. CORRECTION 2: the doc's `cwd` half is ALREADY hardened here — NavigationContext.tsx:686-690 rejects any workdir other than 'user_default'/'none' with 'Project folders must be selected through a validated project handle', and `mode` is validated through parsePermissionMode. The gap is specifically the prompt-execution half (send=true) and the destructive action routes, not directory selection. CORRECTION 3: `send=true` is not a stray parameter — it is the mechanism EditPopover.tsx:1089 uses for its own in-app 'Edit resource' flow via buildNewSessionDeepLink (new-session-deep-link.ts:51, whose unit test asserts the URL must carry send=true). Any fix must keep the internal caller working, so the correct shape is an origin/trust distinction between an in-process dispatch and an OS-delivered URL, not deleting the parameter.
